caption: The drawing depicts an ornately decorated interior room with a Victorian-era appearance. The floor is covered in a green checkered carpet, and a matching green-patterned area rug is placed centrally in front of a round table with gold legs and a bouquet of flowers in a vase atop it. To the left is a tufted, gold-upholstered chair with a lacy pillow, a folded fan, and a teacup on a saucer resting on its arm. Near the chair, two gift boxes sit on the floor, and an envelope lies on the step in the foreground. The back wall features a large window with intricate stained glass, showcasing floral and circular motifs in shades of pink, green, and blue. A golden chandelier with a milk glass shade and elaborate scrollwork hangs from the ceiling. A peacock with blue and green feathers perches on the wooden banister, its tail cascading down the stairs. The right side of the image has an intricately carved bust of a woman with an elaborate hairstyle, displayed on a pedestal. A pale straw hat with a pink ribbon hangs on the banister post. The staircase to the right leads to an upper level, partially visible and decorated with framed pictures, a chair, and a small table with a vase. The wallpaper is blue-green with a subtle pattern, and to the far left is part of an open door, revealing a fringed lampshade atop a blue and gold lamp, and a leafy view outside. The overall composition includes rich, detailed elements and a harmonious color scheme dominated by greens, golds, and pastels.
title: Second Floor Stair Landing and Hall
